event_description_zh: 沿用既有短週期：兩爐同開120秒，停止後繼續排風至240秒。不是一頓完整中餐的實測排放量。
cleaning_timing: end of day; report both post-clean stock and peak before cleaning
between_events_assumptions: All counted deposits remain attached until scheduled cleaning; no resuspension, aging, oxidation, drip, or vapour condensation. Each event has identical flow and particle-size distribution. Residual airborne mass after 240 s is reported separately, not silently assigned to ceiling.

materials.label_zh: 防潮石膏板＋普通啞光乳膠漆
防潮石膏板＋耐擦洗 Satin 廚衛漆

material_note_zh: 三種材料使用同一附著率範圍，沒有量測資料支持為某種漆指定較低附著率，亦沒有把可擦洗性當作低沉積。此輪不改材料導熱或表面溫度；另以天花溫差敏感度呈現。所有長期數值為累積模型情境，不是黃變、厚度或壽命預測。
